title: Integrability of Freely Infinitely Divisible Distributions and Lévy Measures
summary: Under a growth condition on an increasing function $g$, we prove that integrability of a freely infinitely divisible distribution with respect to $g$ is equivalent to that of the large-jump part of its free Lévy measure. For every increasing freely submultiplicative function $g$, integrability of the distribution implies integrability of the large-jump part of its free Lévy measure.
